items.headline: Matt Barrie explains why Florida vs. Auburn will be fascinating
items.description: SEC Nation's Barrie joins The Paul Finebaum Show and breaks down how Tigers' Alex Golesh and Gators' Jon Sumrall will make this matchup enticing to watch.

items.headline: Tim Tebow analyzes pressure between Florida and Auburn ahead of matchup
items.description: SEC Network's Tebow describes the defensive strength of the Tigers and the Gators' explosive offensive unit as he discusses what both sides must keep in mind on Saturday.

items.headline: Auburn's Alex Golesh explains competition between SEC head coaches
items.description: Golesh illustrates on The Paul Finebaum Show the balance of having relationships with head coaches in the conference but also keeping that edge and win at a high level.

items.headline: Auburn AD Cohen on selecting Golesh: 'He's real'
items.description: Auburn athletics director John Cohen joins The Paul Finebaum Show and details the process behind hiring Alex Golesh and why he believes Golesh is the right fit for the Tigers.

items.headline: How coaches returning to their former stomping grounds have fared
items.description: Lane Kiffin's long-awaited return to Oxford comes Saturday. It's not the first time a big-name coach -- or Kiffin himself -- has returned to a vengeful campus.

items.headline: College football Week 3 preview: Can Ole Miss take down LSU?
items.description: This weekend's schedule has plenty of intriguing matchups beyond the little tussle in Oxford.
